links_touching_record.rationale: The use case is enabled by the item definition and its operational situations are drawn from the definition's situations; the link records that direction so the item's boundary is the reason the use case exists.

The system requirement refines the operational scenario's obligation into a measurable system-level statement. The use case is the parent and the requirement is the child, which is the direction refines runs in everywhere in this registry.

The measure validates the driver's need and the traction overvoltage use case, judging by whether the vehicle remains controllable and by whether the driver can state what happened. The relation is validates rather than verifies because the target is a stakeholder need or a use case, not a requirement: validation addresses intent and operational scenario, and the master prompt separates it from requirement verification for exactly that reason.

main_success_scenario.action: The cell voltage rises above the configured maximum limit
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The item classifies the violation after the debounce and requests the safe state

main_success_scenario.action: The item commands the contactors open
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: All high-voltage contactors open within the fault-tolerant time interval

main_success_scenario.action: The vehicle coasts to a stop
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: Steering and brake assist remain available throughout
An unambiguous statement that the battery has been isolated for a battery fault

main_success_scenario.action: The item remains in the fault mode after the vehicle has stopped
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The fault is latched and does not clear on its own

operational_scenarios.expected_item_behaviour: Detect, confirm, command open, confirm open, latch the fault and indicate it
operational_scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Vehicle coasts to a stop with steering and brakes available; driver is told the cause
operational_scenarios.observable_by: The end-user driver, and the vehicle manufacturer from the item's published state
operational_scenarios.operational_situation: Vehicle in motion under traction, pack discharging
operational_scenarios.perturbation: One cell driven above the configured maximum limit at 20 mV/s
operational_scenarios.safe_state_interaction: Reached. This is the scenario in which the safe state costs the vehicle its propulsion, which is why the reaction is specified per mode rather than once.

operational_scenarios.expected_item_behaviour: The same detect-and-react chain, but the reaction also terminates the regeneration, so the converter must tolerate an abrupt load removal
operational_scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: As above; the converter's tolerance is the vehicle manufacturer's dependency and is not verified here
operational_scenarios.operational_situation: Vehicle in motion under regenerative braking, pack charging under load
operational_scenarios.perturbation: Regeneration drives a cell above the configured maximum limit

operational_scenarios.expected_item_behaviour: The item treats loss of the measurement link as requiring the safe state rather than as a tolerable fault
operational_scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Contactors open and the fault is logged
operational_scenarios.observable_by: The vehicle manufacturer, from the item's published state
operational_scenarios.operational_situation: Post-crash, pack state unknown, insulation possibly lost
operational_scenarios.perturbation: Item loses its measurement link entirely
operational_scenarios.safe_state_interaction: Reached. Note that post-crash behaviour may be governed by the vehicle-level item instead; this scenario records the hypothetical project's assumption that the battery item acts on its own, which is an assumption and not an agreement.

postconditions: The vehicle is stationary with the contactors open.
The fault is latched and the item will not leave the fault mode without an authorised service action.
preconditions: The vehicle is in motion under traction discharge, so opening the contactors removes propulsion rather than adding hazard.
The pack is at a normal state of charge.
The independent hardware monitor is present and armed.
